docs.summary: This study is testing a medicine called surlorian in adults who have a genetic muscle condition known as autosomal dominant RYR1-related myopathy (RYR1-RM). The goal is to find out whether surlorian improves muscle weakness, and whether it is safe and well tolerated.

conditions: Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction

docs.summary: Efficacy, safety and tolerability of switching from GLP-1RA to maridebart cafraglutide in adults with obesity or overweight.

docs.title: Finerenone in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation With Heart Failure
docs.sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine
conditions: HFpEF - Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction
docs.summary: This study is a multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial. The purpose is to evaluate whether treatment with finerenone in patients with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis undergoing TAVI, and heart failure with LVEF ≥40% is associated with a reduction in the composite endpoint of all-cause mortality or worsening of heart failure. Participants are patients with symptomatic aortic stenosis undergoing TAVI and heart failure with LVEF≥40%. docs.title: A Study of Donanemab (LY3002813) in Participants With Early Cognitive Decline (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 7)
docs.summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate whether treatment with donanemab slows the progression of cognitive (how we think, learn, remember, pay attention, and make decisions) and functional (how we are able to perform daily activities) decline. For each participant, the study will last one and a half years.

docs.title: A Study to Evaluate Mosunetuzumab in Participants With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus With or Without Active Lupus Nephritis
docs.summary: This study will assess how mosunetuzumab works in people who have systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) who may or may not also have active lupus nephritis (LN).

docs.title: A Study of Aleniglipron in Adults With Obesity or Overweight and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (ACCOMPLISH-2)
docs.sponsor: Gasherbrum Bio, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Structure Therapeutics
docs.summary: This is randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of the long-term efficacy, safety, and tolerability of multiple doses of aleniglipron in participants living with overweight or obesity and T2DM. Participants will be randomized to aleniglipron or placebo for a total of 76 weeks of treatment.

docs.title: Efficacy and Safety of Immunoglobulin Plus Firsekibart in Patients With Kawasaki Disease
docs.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of the addition of Firsekibart to standard initial treatment (intravenous immunoglobulin \[IVIG\] plus aspirin) in children with Acute Kawasaki Disease (KD) .

docs.title: A Study of Trontinemab in Cognitively Unimpaired Individuals at Risk for Progression to Symptomatic Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of trontinemab in participants with biomarker evidence of Alzheimer's Disease (AD) pathology but with no cognitive or functional impairment, who are at risk for progression to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) due to AD or dementia due to AD.

Researchers want to know if regular mental tasks (cognitive training) can improve brain function in older adults. They also want to know if psilocybin, a compound found in certain mushrooms, can further support improved brain function.

docs.title: Safety and Efficacy of ABBV-295 in Adults With Obesity or Overweight With Weight-Related Comorbidities
docs.summary:
Obesity is a condition where a person has excessive body fat, defined by a body mass index (BMI) of 30 kg/m2 or higher. The goal of this study is to evaluate the effect of various doses of ABBV-295 compared to placebo on reducing body weight at Week 32 in participants with obesity or overweight with weight-related comorbidities.

docs.title: Supplementation of Gut-brain Axis (GLP-1)-Activating Carbohydrates for Increasing Satiety in Adolescents With Obesity
docs.summary: Glucagon-like peptide (GLP1) drugs have quickly become a standard treatment for the adults with obesity. These drugs target the appetite control center of the brain, which clows the rate of stomach emptying, and makes a person feel full. The researchers are exploring this response in children. This study is being conducted to better understand how two food carbohydrates affect the appetite control center of the brain. The investigators want to see if a special carbohydrate powder that is mixed with 1 cup of water twice a day will appetite.

docs.title: AV-1959R Vaccine in Individuals With Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This Phase 2 study will evaluate the safety, tolerability, immunogenicity, and amyloid-lowering effect of AV-1959R in cognitively unimpaired adults with preclinical Alzheimer's disease. Approximately 160 participants will be randomized to receive AV-1959R or placebo and will be followed for 78 weeks. The study will assess safety, immune responses, brain amyloid, and Alzheimer's disease-related biomarkers.

docs.title: Peer Support for Family Caregivers of Older Adults Living With Dementia
docs.summary: Family caregivers of people living with dementia are at high risk of poor health when caregiving for their loved one. Peer Support for Family Caregivers of Older Adults Living with Dementia (Pair 2 Care©) is a simple, nonjudgmental, flexible, and potentially scalable peer support program developed with and for family caregivers along with former (previous) caregivers, community leaders, and healthcare providers. docs.summary:

docs.title: PROACT AYA: Preventing Overweight/Obesity-Associated Cardiotoxicity With Tirzepatide In Adolescent And Young Adult Cancer Survivors - A Phase 2 Single-Arm, Single-Center Feasibility Study
docs.summary: This is a prospective, single-arm, open-label feasibility trial conducted at the MD Anderson Sarcoma Center and Cardio-Oncology Clinic. The study will enroll young adults (18-39 years) with soft tissue or bone sarcoma who are overweight (BMI 25-29.9 kg/m² with ≥1 cardiovascular risk factor) or obese (BMI ≥30 kg/m²), have completed Dox-based chemotherapy (≥300 mg/m²) approximately three months prior to enrollment, and have preserved LVEF (≥50%) preenrollment.

docs.title: Ramipril vs. Amlodipine in Pediatric Hemodialysis Patients
docs.summary:

docs.title: A Study of EloraTZP in Adult Participants With Obesity Without Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of eloralintide and tirzepatide coformulation (EloraTZP) compared with tirzepatide, eloralintide and placebo for body weight reduction in participants with obesity.

Participation in the study will last about 2 years.

docs.title: A Study of EloraTZP in Adult Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of eloralintide and tirzepatide coformulation (EloraTZP) compared to tirzepatide for body weight reduction in participants with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes.

Participation in the study will last about 2 years.

docs.title: A Study to Learn About the Monthly Dosing Study Medicine Called Berobenatide in Adults With Breathing Problems During Sleep and Overweight or Obesity Who Do Not Use a Breathing Machine (PAP) (VESPER-OSA 2)
docs.summary:
This study is being done to learn about the safety and effects of a study medicine called berobenatide (bear-oh-BEN-uh-tide). docs.title: IGOB131 As A GLP-1 Modulator For Metabolic Disorders In Adults With Obesity
docs.summary:
This clinical trial will investigate the effect of standardized Irvingia gabonensis extract (IGOB131) on GLP-1 dynamics, DPP-4 activity, metabolic parameters, and inflammatory markers in adults with obesity.

The study will compare IGOB131 to a placebo to find out if it exerts any significant metabolic benefits through GLP-1 and DPP-4 modulation, and the reduction of adiposity and systemic inflammation.

docs.title: Randomized Interventional Clinical Trial on the Prevention of Atrial Fibrillation Using Colchicine, Amiodarone And a Posterior Pericardiotomy.
docs.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if a bundle of three treatments can prevent atrial fibrillation, a heart rhythm disorder often observed in adults following heart surgery. Atrial fibrillation is associated with increased risks of stroke and heart failure. The bundle consists of two drugs (colchicine and amiodarone) as well as a simple surgical technique called posterior pericardiotomy. docs.title: A Study to Investigate the Effect of LY4086940 Versus Placebo in Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Without Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study, performed under the master protocol W8M-MC- CWMM (NCT06143956), is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of LY4086940 compared with placebo in participants without type 2 diabetes who have obesity or who have overweight with a weight-related health condition.

Participation in the study will last about 58 weeks.

docs.title: Immune Checkpoint Blockade and Chemotherapy With or Without Fecal Microbiota Transplant in Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
docs.summary: This study is being done to answer the following question: Can adding a treatment called Fecal Microbiota Transplant (FMT) to the usual treatment delay the growth or spread of cancer better than the usual treatment alone? FMT treatment changes the bacteria in the gut called the microbiome.

docs.title: A Study of PLS240 in Pediatric Participants With Secondary Hyperparathyroidism and Chronic Kidney Disease on Hemodialysis
docs.summary:
Approximately 56 participants who are 1 month old to 17 years old will be enrolled in this study. The total duration for this study will be 38 weeks (or up to 42 weeks when participants require a washout period due to prior exposure to prohibited medications) and includes the following periods:

* Active screening period of 6 weeks (or, up to 10 weeks for participants requiring a washout period).
* Treatment period of 28 weeks consisting of a 19-week dose titration period and 9-week stable dose period.
* Safety follow-up period of 4 weeks.
